tldr: Wealthsimple dominated the news with its 'Wealthsimple Presents' launch: the Penny AI assistant, instant Wealthsimple Pay transfers, commission-free CAD options and a CADD stablecoin. Meanwhile the big Canadian banks are moving to block third-party AI agents while using AI internally (BMO) and sweetening everyday card rewards (RBC).
themes: AI assistants and agents, in-app and in the contact centre
Big banks restricting third-party AI agents
Wealthsimple broadening into trading, payments and stablecoins
Crypto and stablecoin access (and its operational risk)

highlights.headline: Wealthsimple unveiled Penny, an AI assistant that prepares e-transfers, invoice payments and trades (always with client confirmation), plus Wealthsimple Pay (instant transfers up to $100K between clients) and temporary virtual cards.
highlights.why: This is the most direct DIY-segment threat: it sets a new bar for AI-assisted and instant-money-movement features just as Simplii pilots Folders and payment backup.

highlights.headline: Wealthsimple launched commission-free options on Canadian stocks, is bringing out the Wealthsimple Pro platform (Level 2 data) in late November, and plans the CADD stablecoin with a 3.25% reward and a no-FX-fee business credit card for early 2027.
highlights.why: It keeps widening the value gap for self-directed investors, which pressures Simplii's CIBC Investor's Edge-linked investing proposition and its stated 'control and value' positioning.

highlights.headline: RBC, TD, BMO, CIBC and Scotiabank are blocking or limiting third-party AI agents from authenticated online banking, citing fraud and customer data risk.
highlights.why: CIBC, Simplii's parent, is part of this group, so the team needs a clear position on agent access, security and liability as customers start to expect AI agents.

highlights.headline: RBC rebuilt its Cash Back Mastercard line with uncapped 3% everyday categories (effective Oct 1) and $1 on-demand redemptions from December 2026.
highlights.why: This raises the bar for everyday cash-back value and redemption flexibility, which matters for Simplii's card offer and for how easily customers can access their rewards.
